slice: DA d2_seq100 proxy, n=100, synonym_bind OFF
purpose: Block-1 assumes matched candidate budget and comparable ranking depth across AB01/AB02/AB03; this audit measures whether that held.

violations.candidate_budget_not_matched: mean L2 leaves diverge from M00: per-parent generation emits ~5-6 children per L1, so pool size scales with the number of L1 families. Raising l2_candidate_max_per_live_family / candidate_budget only widens the recall pool fed to L2RecallCreator, not the number of emitted leaves.
violations.ab02_ranking_depth_collapsed: Joint keeps one champion per L1 parent; a single FLAT parent yields one champion, so the arbiter ranks a single leaf in 100/100 cases and option@2 equals option@1 by construction.
violations.empty_rankings_confound_ab03: Empty joint rankings leave the mapper with no leaf to project, scoring as a miss; AB03/AB01 hit this far more than M00, so their deltas mix axis quality with a pipeline failure mode.
